test-other-prefix.name: module-tidy
test-other-prefix.command:
go mod tidy
git diff --exit-code -- go.mod go.sum

test-other-prefix.name: lifecycle-helpers
test-other-prefix.command:
git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 29edc2a6e13e27867603a23ff5b1b5a8d1b84df0
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s internal/lifecyclecheck -p test_harness.py

fast.name: go-format
fast.command:
files=$(gofmt -l internal/app/backupcmd_test.go internal/sheet/first_commit_test.go)
if [ -n "$files" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$files"; exit 1; fi

netbird.name: netbird-tidy
netbird.command:
go mod tidy
git diff --exit-code -- go.mod go.sum

netbird.name: no-netbird-linkage
netbird.command:
if go list -deps ./cmd/flats | grep -q github.com/netbirdio; then echo 'cmd/flats links NetBird' >&2; exit 1; fi
if grep -q '^replace' go.mod; then echo 'go.mod has replace directives' >&2; exit 1; fi

browser.name: sheet-browser

legacy.name: legacy-fetch
legacy.command:
git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 29edc2a6e13e27867603a23ff5b1b5a8d1b84df0
test "$(git cat-file -t 29edc2a6e13e27867603a23ff5b1b5a8d1b84df0)" = commit

macos.name: approval-helpers
macos.command:
sh -n scripts/container-smoke.sh
for gate_script in scripts/approval-gate.sh scripts/server-flat-gate.sh scripts/tailnet-gate.sh scripts/agent-gate.sh scripts/lifecycle-gate.sh; do
  bash -n "$gate_script" || exit 1
done
python3 -B scripts/test_approval_gate.py

macos.name: macos-archive
macos.command:
FLATS_RELEASE_TARGETS="$(go env GOOS)/$(go env GOARCH)"
export FLATS_RELEASE_TARGETS
scripts/build-release.sh v0.0.0-ci "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist"

container.name: shell-lint
container.command:
shellcheck -s sh install.sh scripts/ci-test.sh scripts/ci-race.sh scripts/ci-memory.sh scripts/build-release.sh scripts/install-smoke.sh scripts/container-smoke.sh scripts/build-commit-image.sh scripts/build-commit-images.sh scripts/lib-gate.sh
shellcheck -s bash scripts/approval-gate.sh scripts/server-flat-gate.sh scripts/tailnet-gate.sh scripts/agent-gate.sh scripts/lifecycle-gate.sh

container.name: approval-helpers
container.command:
sh -n scripts/container-smoke.sh
for gate_script in scripts/approval-gate.sh scripts/server-flat-gate.sh scripts/tailnet-gate.sh scripts/agent-gate.sh scripts/lifecycle-gate.sh; do
  bash -n "$gate_script" || exit 1
done
python3 -B scripts/test_approval_gate.py

container.name: systemd-manager
container.command:
sudo loginctl enable-linger "$USER"
runtime=/run/user/$(id -u)
for _ in $(seq 1 30); do [ -S "$runtime/bus" ] && break; sleep 1; done
[ -S "$runtime/bus" ] || { echo "systemd user bus did not appear at $runtime/bus"; exit 1; }

container.name: container-smoke
container.command:
tar -xzf dist/flats_linux_amd64.tar.gz -C "$RUNNER_TEMP" flats
scripts/container-smoke.sh flats:ci v0.0.0-ci "$RUNNER_TEMP/flats"
